info.title: NexusFlow API
info.description: REST API for NexusFlow. Every response uses { success, data } or { success: false, error }. Requests that change data must send the header X-Requested-With: NexusFlow.

get.summary: Liveness check: answers while the server process is running
Readiness check: also confirms the database answers

200.description: The server and database are ready

post.summary: Create an account, sign in and send a verification email

200.description: The email already has an account; its owner was emailed (no details revealed)

post.summary: Sign in with email and password

200.description: Signed in; sets the nf_session cookie

429.description: Locked after 5 failed attempts in 15 minutes (TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS)

post.summary: Confirm an email address with the token from the emailed link

400.description: Link used, replaced or expired (TOKEN_INVALID, TOKEN_EXPIRED)

post.summary: Send a new verification email (1 a minute, 5 a day)
Email a password reset link (same answer whether or not the account exists)
Set a new password with the emailed token; signs out every device

400.description: Invalid or expired link, or weak password

post.summary: Confirm your password before a sensitive action (valid 5 minutes)
Change your password; signs out your other devices

get.summary: List the devices where you are signed in

patch.summary: Update your name or time zone (send only what changed)

400.description: Invalid name or unknown time zone (VALIDATION_ERROR)

delete.summary: Delete your account (confirm your password with /auth/reauthenticate first)

403.description: Password not confirmed in the last 5 minutes (REAUTH_REQUIRED)

409.description: You own an organization; transfer or delete it first (SOLE_OWNER)

post.summary: Get a one-time signed upload to send a profile photo straight to Cloudinary

200.description: Upload address and signed form fields

503.description: Photo upload is not set up (STORAGE_NOT_CONFIGURED)

post.summary: Check the uploaded photo with Cloudinary and make it your profile photo

400.description: Not your upload or not a valid photo (UPLOAD_INVALID)

get.summary: Which optional features are set up on this server
Start “Continue with Google” (a browser redirect to Google)

404.description: Google sign-in is not set up (NOT_FOUND)

get.summary: Where Google sends the browser back; signs in and redirects into the app

302.description: Redirect into the app, or to /login?error=… if sign-in failed
